phrases.say: Getting a vehicle out of the port
It tells you the vessel, the date, and what you owe.
It also says whether the original Bill of Lading is needed.
A stamp like this means the original was surrendered overseas.
It should name Ship2Shore Booking in the Local Delivery or Transfer By box.
Once everything is cleared, the terminal issues a gate pass with your driver's name and time window.
Most holds come down to four things: steamship line charges, roll-on roll-off charges, customs clearance, or the original Bill of Lading.
We find out which one and tell you what to do.
We handle the port side. You don't have to.
